d:
jay shri ram! jay siyaram! shri ram ki bhakti men man ko lin kar dene vala sundar bhajan 'bhajo re man ram ram' prastut hai. prabhu shri ram ka nam jivan men shanti, shraddha aur sakaratmakta ka sanchar karta hai.
Is bhaktimay bhajan ke madhyam se prabhu shri ram ke pavan nam ka smaran karen aur ram nam ki mahima ka aanand len. madhusmita ke madhur svaron men prastut yah bhajan har ram bhakt ke man men bhakti aur shraddha ka bhav jagrit karta hai.
Aaie, prem aur bhaktibhav se milkar prabhu shri ram ka gungan karen.
Ram Bhajan: Bhajo Re Man Ram Ram
Singer: Madhusmita
Music Director: Dilip Sen
